From time to time, we present selected GAAP-basis financial results, excluding notable items. Notable items are revenues, expenses, other income (expense) and tax related items that are not indicative of ongoing operating performance and outside of the Company&#x2019;s normal course of business, including merger, acquisition and restructuring charges or gains/losses on sales or other notables (collectively, &#x201c;notable items&#x201d;). We define Operating leverage, excluding notable items, as the year-over-year percentage change in revenues less the year-over-year percentage change in expenses, excluding notable items, for the respective period. We define EBITDA margin as EBITDA divided by revenues. We define free cash flow as net cash provided by/(used in) operating activities excluding the net change in trading investments and net change in securities failed-to-deliver and securities failed-to-receive from broker-dealers, clearing organizations and customers, less expenditures for furniture, equipment and leasehold improvements and capitalized software development costs. Non-GAAP financial measures should be considered in addition to, not as a substitute for or superior to, financial measures determined in conformity with GAAP. The Company believes that these non-GAAP financial measures, when taken into consideration with the corresponding GAAP financial measures, provide additional information regarding the Company&#x2019;s operating results because they assist both investors and management in analyzing and evaluating the performance of our business. Please refer to Tables 8A, 8B, 9 and 10 for a reconciliation of: (i) selected GAAP-basis financial results, each excluding notable items, to their most directly comparable GAAP measure; (ii) GAAP net income to EBITDA and GAAP net income margin to EBITDA margin; and (iii) GAAP net cash provided by/(used in) operating activities to free cash flow, in each case, the most directly comparable GAAP measure.</font></p><h2 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#5c84c4;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">ICE Transaction</font></h2><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">On July 29, 2026, MarketAxess entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the &#x201c;Merger Agreement&#x201d;) with Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (&#x201c;ICE&#x201d;) and Igloo Merger Sub II, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of ICE. Under the Merger Agreement, the ICE subsidiary will merge with and into MarketAxess (the &#x201c;Merger&#x201d;), and MarketAxess will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of ICE. At the effective time of the Merger, each outstanding share of MarketAxess common stock will be converted into the right to receive $167.00 in cash, without interest, other than certain excluded shares, including shares held by stockholders who properly exercise appraisal rights under Delaware law. On October 21, 2026, the Department of Justice and the Federal Trade Commission granted early termination of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended, applicable to the Merger. Completion of the Merger remains subject to MarketAxess stockholder approval, the receipt of required regulatory approvals and the satisfaction or waiver of the other closing conditions in the Merger Agreement.      </table><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:3pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:3pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:5.36pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:5.36pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">1</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> Effective with the release of our January 2026 trading volume statistics, the Company revised certain aspects of its reporting methodology for estimated market share to provide a more comprehensive view of platform activity and enhance comparability with industry peers. The Company now highlights estimated market share for U.S. high-grade and U.S. high-yield on an all-in basis, which includes single-dealer portfolio trading activity, and the Company no longer reports estimated market share on an &#34;excluding single-dealer portfolio trading&#34; basis. Single-dealer portfolio trading activity continues to be excluded from the &#x201c;Total credit trading (excl. SD PT)&#x201d; and &#34;Total trading (excl. SD PT)&#34; lines in Table 4 and the &#x201c;Total Credit&#x201d; FPM calculation in Table 1B. As used in Table 4 to highlight the effect of single-dealer portfolio trading on U.S. high-grade and U.S. high-yield ADVs, &#x201c;SD PT&#x201d; means single-dealer portfolio trades.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:5.36pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:5.36pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">2</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> &#x201c;Other credit&#x201d; includes municipal bonds, leveraged loans, convertible bonds and structured products.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:5.36pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:5.36pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">3</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> The number of U.S. trading days is based on the SIFMA holiday recommendation calendar.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:5.36pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:5.36pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">4</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> The number of U.K. trading days is based on the U.K. Bank holiday schedule.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:8pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">* Consistent with FINRA TRACE reporting standards, both sides of trades are included in the Company's reported volumes when the Company executes trades on a matched principal basis between two counterparties. Consistent with industry standards, U.S. government bond trades are single-counted.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#1d5b7f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Table 5: Estimated Market Share</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p>

The Company now highlights estimated market share for U.S. high-grade and U.S. high-yield on an all-in basis, which includes single-dealer portfolio trading activity, and the Company no longer reports estimated market share on an &#34;excluding single-dealer portfolio trading&#34; basis. Single-dealer portfolio trading activity continues to be excluded from the &#x201c;Total credit trading (excl. SD PT)&#x201d; and &#34;Total trading (excl. SD PT)&#34; lines in Table 4 and the &#x201c;Total Credit&#x201d; FPM calculation in Table 1B. As used in Table 4 to highlight the effect of single-dealer portfolio trading on U.S. high-grade and U.S. high-yield ADVs, &#x201c;SD PT&#x201d; means single-dealer portfolio trades.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:5.36pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;vertical-align:super;font-size:5.36pt;line-height:1.5;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">2</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> The Company estimates that duplicative affiliate trade reports accounted for up to 6% of reported U.S. high-grade TRACE volume in 3Q26. In July 2026, the SEC approved a FINRA rule change that will suppress public dissemination of these duplicative reports, with mandatory compliance beginning in August 2027. Adjusting for these duplicates, the Company believes its estimated U.S. high-grade market share would have been up to approximately 100bps higher in 3Q26.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:7pt;margin-top:0;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:7pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:0.5in;width:7.5in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:0.5in;"><div style="flex-grow:1;"></div><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.5in;min-height:0.7in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:9pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="color:#636569;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Page </font><font style="color:#636569;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:9pt;font-family:'Calibri',sans-serif;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">10</font></p></div></div></div>
